intro.lead: Configure fields and rules. Angular renders the form.
intro.try: Edit label, required, minLength or maxLength. Set the value in model.name.
intro.configurationError: Use valid JSON with key "name", type "input", props (label, required, positive minLength and maxLength with minLength ≤ maxLength), and validation.messages.minLength (a message or translation key, 1–200 characters).
intro.additionalFields: Email, select options and conditional fields
intro.template: Bind the fields and model to Angular

skill.lead: Describe the form. Review the generated configuration.
skill.promptTitle: Give the skill a real task
skill.prompt: Use the ngx-formly skill to implement a team-day registration form directly in subsection 04.1 (#chapter-04-result). Replace the placeholder in src/components/skill-result.ts with the working form. Reuse DemoFormState and our registered input, select and textarea types. Require a full name and a valid email. Offer in-person or online attendance. Show dietary requirements only for in-person attendees and clear the value when hidden. Include a collapsible model preview. Keep the configuration editable and exportable in chapter 05, and support English, German and French. Make the changes in this repository and verify the form and build.
